import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { useMutation, gql } from '@apollo/client'; import './AddShipmentModal.css'; const ADD_SHIPMENT_MUTATION = gql` mutation AddShipment($input: ShipmentInput!) { addShipment(input: $input) { id trackingNumber origin destination status carrier weight dimensions estimatedDelivery customerName customerEmail } } `; const AddShipmentModal = ({ onClose, onSuccess }) => { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ trackingNumber: '', origin: '', destination: '', status: 'PENDING', carrier: '', weight: '', dimensions: '', estimatedDelivery: '', customerName: '', customerEmail: '', }); const [addShipment, { loading }] = useMutation(ADD_SHIPMENT_MUTATION, { onCompleted: () => { onSuccess(); }, onError: (error) => { alert('Error adding shipment: ' + error.message); }, }); const handleInputChange = (e) => { const { name, value } = e.target; setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value })); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); addShipment({ variables: { input: { ...formData, weight: parseFloat(formData.weight), estimatedDelivery: formData.estimatedDelivery ? `${formData.estimatedDelivery}T00:00:00.000Z` : null, }, }, }); }; return (
e.stopPropagation()}>
